messages:
infra-bot: IALERT 7065432100 — multiple CUDA OOMs + container crashes on inference-node-9 (us-west1-gpu). Auto-evict triggered, starting diagnostics and live mitigation.
sanjay: seeing slow resident growth on node-9; kv cache resident + paged-attn allocator creeping ~2%/hr. flamegraph + heatmap uploaded: https://redwood.metrics/graphs/7065432100
kelly: @mike are you on call? can you take triage?
mike: oncall here, grabbing logs. tailing /var/log/redwood/runtime.log shows repeated "CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY at attention_packer.cu:412" and "kv_page_alloc: failed to find slot". Pods keep restarting.
sanjay: provisional mitigation: cordon node (kubectl cordon inference-node-9) and set eviction env on pods to force kv trim.
kelly: cordon command executed :white_check_mark:
mike: patching deployment to set REDWOOD_KV_EVICT_PCT=15 and REDWOOD_BATCH_SIZE=1 for pods on node-9, will restart pods one-by-one to avoid mass disruption. applying now.
sanjay: also flipping paged allocator debug flags: echo "paged_allocator_debug=1" > /etc/redwood/flags && rolling-restart service/inference
mike: rolling restarts in progress. first pod restarted, logs show OOMs stopped for that instance. continuing.
kelly: customer impact — ops dashboard shows 12% error rate for us-west routes, 3 customers above 5% error threshold. CS notified with initial ping: "We're mitigating elevated errors in us-west; update in 15m." :email:
mike: changing routing fallback to rdx-small for us-west: applying policy rule to route >95th percentile memory requests to rdx-small to reduce pressure. config snippet: 
```
route { region: "us-west" fallback_model: "rdx-small" threshold: "memory>75%" }
```
sanjay: starting kv-compact job on node-9 to reclaim fragmented slabs. running /opt/redwood/bin/kv-compact --node inference-node-9
mike: kv-compact running; some immediate reclaimed pages, OOMs ceased. residual high RSS persists due to retained KV fragments from long sessions.
infra-bot: INCIDENT CREATED INC-2026-0421. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/incidents/kv-paged-oom. Triage lead: mike. Severity: Sev2. Handoff checklist posted.
kelly: sent customer follow-ups to affected accounts with mitigation summary and ETA for next update. also opened urgent support ticket for any customer-visible retries.
mike: heap profile collected (heap-prof-7065432115). profile indicates many small kv allocations pinned by long-lived chat sessions; paged-attn interacts poorly with slab allocator when sequences exceed 8k tokens.
sanjay: short-term follow-ups: 1) ensure kv eviction is enforced cluster-wide; 2) add periodic background compaction job; 3) lower default batch size for hotspot nodes. I'll file PRs.
mike: created follow-up ticket RW-2345: "kv paged allocator: periodic compaction + safer eviction thresholds". Assigning to eng-runtime.
kelly: handing off monitoring to @darren for next shift. darren: ack, taking over monitoring and oncall checks. :eyes:
darren: will watch latency/error rates overnight and escalate if memory creep resumes. please ping me if further customer impact arises.
mike: notes for postmortem: likely root cause = allocator fragmentation + slow leak when attention paging triggers repeated small allocations; mitigations that helped: cordon node, env-based kv eviction, rolling restart, fallback routing to rdx-small, kv-compact script. Long-term: slab rebalancer + background compact + earlier model fallback thresholds.
infra-bot: INCIDENT moved to MONITORING at 7065432125. Next update required in 1h or on any regression.
